_comment: Web App settings. Teams and their members come from the Core API database (/teams, /users). Environment variables override these (see secheck_web/config.py); in Docker, set CORE_API_URL etc. in docker-compose.yml. users is the development sign-in list until the team picks an auth method (gap G-6); each must also be a user in the Core API database. core-gateway is the service user a Core API signs in as when it forwards calls to the Web App; it is hidden from the sign-in picker.
